notes: The closing change sits in one clause of m6 ('need to push closing out to Fri Dec 11') among HOA, walkthrough, warranty and utility chatter, above a quote chain that repeats 'closing Fri Dec 4' twice; Dec 11 still meets the Dec 15 deadline, so we just confirm it. The counter PDF becomes partially stale (its closing date was replaced). m5 has no wire instructions (only 'by phone only'), so no payment term is recorded. The title company restating 12/11 in m8 has no closing authority: tentative, not_authoritative. Distractors: $12,000 EMD, file LT-26-0918, HomeShield $540, movers Dec 9-10, gas acct 4471, phones.
